thread:
anya: quick sync — i'm drafting an interop handoff parity grid for model variants. need to confirm tokenizer behavior + context/cutoff semantics + tool-call footprint across tiers/regions. will post initial table in #eng-platform tomorrow. anyone with recent tool-call regressions?
kevin: pls add region differences — eu customers hit a 2k context cap on v1-llama, earlier than us-east. :thinking_face:
maria: saw this with dedicated pools — kv-cache bits differ when quantized; tool-call payloads sometimes drop metadata headers. example log: ```ERR toolcall: missing-meta header x-user-id```
raj: can we formalize expected behavior: tokenizer should be deterministic across variants with same model family; context cutoff must prefer emitting truncated system messages not partial JSON. propose policy: prefer shorter-system-truncation.
sylvie: UX note: in console rollouts page show 'hand-off parity score' with columns tokenizer/context/toolcall and a pass/fail gauge. don't expose internal kernel details to users.
anya: good. also need telemetry events: model.variant.handoff.failure with tags: region, tier, tokenizer-diff, toolcall-mismatch. @telemetry-bot can you add a schema?
telemetry-bot: created draft schema https://redwood.internal/schemas/handoff_parity_v1 — includes counts + sample hashes. :white_check_mark:
kevin: small ask — when fallback happens for Enterprise tier we should prefer same tokenizer family even if slower; we can't afford surprises.
maria: agree. also note: tool-calling parity requires keeping function signatures stable. we should ban silent arg renames. add linting to model-onboard pipeline.
raj: does anyone have concrete examples of tokenizer drift between v1 and v2 quantized? I can add token-level diffs.
sylvie: i pasted a short diff earlier in #eng-ml, but here's the gist: v1 splits `user-id:123` into ["user","-","id",":","123"] while v2 keeps ["user-id",":","123"]. small but breaks tool arg parsing.
deploy-bot: deploy started for eng-platform/parity-grid v0.3 at 1719994620
anya: plan: I'll assemble table tomorrow; action items: raj collect token diffs, maria collect toolcall logs, kevin check region caps, sylvie prototype console gauge. meeting Weds 10am if needed. :calendar:
kevin: +1
maria: ok
raj: on it
telemetry-bot: will emit sample logs to es for testing, index: handoff_parity_samples-2024. :rocket:
